name: Uptime and redundancy
answer: These measures show how reliably a data center keeps its servers running and connected: network quality, backup power and contractual uptime. An AI training run can last weeks across thousands of chips, so an interruption costs more than in most workloads.

metrics.line: Continuous measurement of round-trip latency, loss rate, and utilization on the facility's internal fabric and external transit.
metrics.label: Network latency, packet loss, and bandwidth

metrics.line: Battery state of health and remaining runtime under current load, and on-site fuel measured in hours of generator operation at load.
metrics.label: UPS battery health and generator runtime

metrics.line: Delivered availability measured against the contracted service level, conventionally quoted in nines.
metrics.label: SLA uptime compliance

reading.body:
Uptime in a data center is tracked through three things: network quality, backup power, and contractual availability.

The pattern is that reliability is measured at the layers where it can fail. Latency, packet loss, and bandwidth are watched continuously on the internal fabric and external transit. Battery health and generator runtime are watched as stored energy, batteries by state of health and remaining runtime under load, fuel by hours of generator operation at load. SLA compliance is the delivered result against the contracted number, quoted in nines.

This matters more for AI than for most workloads because a training run can last weeks across thousands of chips. An interruption does not just delay a request, it can waste the work already done. The backup power metrics are the ones that connect directly to the grid: batteries and fuel are what carry a facility through the gap between an outage and restored supply, and they are finite in a way that a grid connection is not.

What the data does not give is any actual figure. There is no latency number, no runtime in hours, no nines value, and no facility named. It describes what is measured, not how any particular site performs.
